summary: Graphex Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC furnishing routine corporate communications related to its upcoming Annual General Meeting, including the notice of AGM, 2025 annual report, a circular on general mandates to repurchase and issue shares and re-election of directors, and proxy forms. These are standard annual meeting materials, not a special situation event. The filing is a foreign private issuer's report of materials published under HKSE Listing Rules. There are no deal terms, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or M&A activity. This is a routine governance filing with no special-situation catalyst.
